convergence.name: max_iterations
convergence.meaning: Stop with stopped(max_iterations) and status not_converged when this many iterations ran without convergence.

convergence.name: translation_tol
convergence.meaning: Converged by increment when the translation step is at or below this length and the rotation step within rotation_tol.

convergence.name: rotation_tol
convergence.meaning: Converged by increment when the rotation step is at or below this angle and the translation step within translation_tol.

convergence.name: objective_rel_tol
convergence.meaning: Converged by objective when the relative objective change is at or below this value on two consecutive iterations.

convergence.name: divergence_window
convergence.meaning: Stop with stopped(diverged) and status not_converged when the objective rose on this many consecutive iterations.
